sec: Miscellaneous: cirrhosis causes, micro vs macrovesicular steatosis, Reye's, nutmeg liver, Mallory-Denk bodies

items.q: Miscellaneous note: what is printed as the most common cause of cirrhosis?
Causes of micronodular cirrhosis — which is NOT in the printed list?
items.exp: Micronodular: Alcoholic hepatitis, Biliary cirrhosis, ICC, Cystic fibrosis, Budd Chiari syndrome, Hemochromatosis. Wilson's is the printed macronodular cause. (Book p1029)

items.q: Which single cause is printed for macronodular cirrhosis?
items.exp: 'Causes of macronodular cirrhosis : Wilson's disease'. (Book p1029)

items.q: Fill up the mnemonic for microvesicular steatosis: 'Pretty visits ______ with Alcohol and ______'.
items.exp: 'mnemonic : Pretty visits Jamaica with Alcohol and Acid.' (Book p1029)

items.q: Decode the mnemonic letters — match — 1) P 2) R 3) T 4) V … A) Tetracycline B) Reye's syndrome C) Valproate D) Pregnancy
items.exp: Microvesicular column: Pregnancy, Reye's syndrome, Tetracycline, Valproate, Jamaican vomiting sickness, Alcoholic liver disease, Acid lipase deficiency. (Book p1029)

items.q: Which condition is listed under MACROvesicular (not microvesicular) steatosis?
items.exp: Macrovesicular: HCV, NASH, Wilson's disease. (Book p1029)

items.q: Judge: I Alcoholic liver disease is placed in the microvesicular column. II HCV and NASH are in the macrovesicular column.
items.exp: Alcoholic liver disease is in the microvesicular list (the 'Alcohol' of the mnemonic); HCV, NASH, Wilson's are macrovesicular. (Book p1029)

items.q: How is Reye's syndrome characterised in the bullet after the table?
items.exp: 'Reye's syndrome : Swollen mitochondria with reduced number.' (Book p1029)

items.q: Mallory–Denk bodies are defined as what, and located where?
opts: Endoplasmic reticulum stress — eosinophilic inclusion bodies in hepatocytes
Mitochondrial stress — basophilic inclusions in Kupffer cells
Copper-bound protein — brown granules in bile ducts
items.exp: 'Mallory denk bodies : Endoplasmic reticulum stress (Eosinophilic inclusion bodies) In hepatocytes.' (Book p1029)

items.q: Mallory–Denk bodies are 'seen in' a printed list. Which is NOT in that list?
items.exp: Seen in: Wilson's, ICC, NASH, Cholestasis, Alcohol/Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency, PBC, HCC. 'Not seen in HBV / HCV.' (Book p1029)

items.q: Judge: I Mallory–Denk bodies are seen in HCC. II They are seen in alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency. III They are seen in HBV.
opts: I and II true, III false
I true, II and III false
III true, I and II false
items.exp: HCC and Alcohol/Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency are in the seen-in list; 'Not seen in HBV / HCV'. (Book p1029)
